summary: We looked at 'Acme Bank' from 2026-10-01 to 2026-10-14 on Telegram, X, YouTube.
We found 727 posts written by 271 different accounts.
The busiest day was 2026-10-05 with 227 posts.
“acme bank” (phrase) was mentioned in 727 posts (100% of everything) by 271 accounts.
People are talking about 13 main things. The biggest (Story 1) is about “BREAKING: Acme Bank is INSOLVENT.”: 233 posts from 28 accounts, mostly on X, 32% of everything.

The next biggest: Story 2 “Acme Bank transfers is completely unusable today while my card is declined at the shop…” (148 posts); Story 3 “Hidden fees at Acme Bank are insane for basic accounts which feels like a cash grab Shop…” (76 posts); Story 4 “Honestly Acme Bank has been solid who answered within minutes which I did not expect Fair…” (57 posts).
We found 3 group(s) of accounts that seem to work together. Together they wrote about 40% of all the posts.

groups.text: Group G1 has 28 accounts that seem to work together. Why we think so: they posted the same or almost the same words; their accounts were made around the same time; they posted within minutes of each other; they keep sharing and boosting each other's posts. This is a clue, not proof: real friends or fans can also look alike.
